title: Tata Steel expects stronger performance in second half of fiscal: CEO
description:
Tata Steel expects to perform significantly better in the second half of the current fiscal than in the first six months, CEO and Managing Director TV Narendran said.
He said steel demand remains strong and market conditions are favourable, while growth in key customer segments such as automobiles and construction has also been encouraging, helping the company post a reasonably good performance in the first half.
However, the conflict in West Asia has had an impact of around Rs 1,000 crore per quarter on the company and about Rs 1,400 crore globally, Narendran said during an interaction with the press on the sidelines of the inauguration of the five-day pan-India tribal conclave 'Samvaad' in Jamshedpur on Sunday.
He acknowledged operational challenges at the company's Kalinganagar and Meramandali plants in Odisha during the first half, but expressed confidence that production and operations would stabilise in the second half.
